@retry.description: Button. Runs a failed request again. Appears in every element.

@invoicesLoading.description: Accessible name for the invoice card while its history loads. Read aloud, never seen.

@invoicesHeader.description: Heading of the invoice history card.

@invoicesCount.description: Count beside the heading when every invoice is on screen. Takes {{count}}.

@invoicesCount_one.description: Count beside the heading when every invoice is on screen. Takes {{count}}.

@invoicesCount_other.description: Count beside the heading when every invoice is on screen. Takes {{count}}.

@invoicesShowing.description: Count beside the heading while more history is loadable. Takes {{shown}} and {{count}}.

@invoicesShowing_one.description: Count beside the heading while more history is loadable. Takes {{shown}} and {{count}}.

@invoicesShowing_other.description: Count beside the heading while more history is loadable. Takes {{shown}} and {{count}}.

@invoicesEmpty.description: Replaces the table when the company has no invoices.

@invoicesDateColumn.description: Column header over each invoice's due date. Also read by assistive technology.

@invoicesAmountColumn.description: Column header over each invoice's amount. Also read by assistive technology.

@invoicesStatusColumn.description: Column header over each invoice's status. Also read by assistive technology.

@invoicesSeeMore.description: Button. Expands the list from its first few rows to everything loaded.

@invoicesSeeLess.description: Button. Collapses the expanded list back to its first few rows.

@invoicesLoadMore.description: Button. Fetches the next page of older invoices from the server.

@invoicesCredit.description: Tooltip on a negative amount, which is a credit note rather than a charge.

@invoicesUndated.description: Text of the link to a hosted invoice, used in place of a date the API sent unusable.

@invoiceStatusDraft.description: Invoice status: not finalized, and not yet owed.

@invoiceStatusOpen.description: Invoice status: finalized and awaiting payment.

@invoiceStatusUncollectible.description: Invoice status: written off after payment failed.

@invoiceStatusVoid.description: Invoice status: cancelled, and never owed.
